_note: Event types for the 2x2 cards. Each has body copy, an icon key and a color photo (file base name in assets/img plus the widths that exist, and an optional focus point for the crop).

events.title: Corporate events
events.blurb: Galas, client appreciation, product launches and holiday parties. A polished live band that keeps the room moving and the schedule on time. Bring the full band for the main event, or an acoustic set for cocktail hour.
events.alt: A guitarist and a saxophonist in blazers and captain hats playing on stage

events.title: Private celebrations
events.blurb: Milestone birthdays, anniversaries and weddings. The songs everyone grew up with, so the dance floor fills itself. Choose the full band for the party, or an acoustic set for a dinner or ceremony.
events.alt: A vocalist in a pink sequin blazer and captain's hat singing, with a second singer behind her

events.title: Festivals & park districts
events.blurb: Daytime or headline slots, outdoor stages and summer series. Full production, with clear tech and logistics info for your producer.
events.alt: Three vocalists in sparkling teal jackets and captain hats singing at the front of the stage

events.title: Theatres & PACs
events.blurb: A seated, concert-ready show built around vocals and musicianship. Acoustic sets also suit smaller rooms. Press kit, stage plot and video available on request.
events.alt: A vocalist in a dark sequin dress singing, with a bandmate in a captain's hat behind her
